description: Parameters of every tool for the published masks (outputs/masks). notebooks/lib/config.py reads this file; the software is located with environment variables (notebooks/REPRODUCIBILITY.md, 'External software'). Five (tool, dataset-contrast) pairs use dataset-specific settings (notebooks/lib/config.py, DATASET_SPECIFIC_SETTINGS). Description: docs/tools_and_conventions.md.

input_rule.image: the dataset image (datasets/<Dk>/<folder>/<stem>.nii.gz; voxel sizes x10 in pixdim and affine, sform = qform), re-oriented losslessly to the canonical orientation of dataset_settings.json (perm, flips) and saved as float32 NIfTI. The same file is given to every tool.
input_rule.output_mask: tool mask on the canonical grid -> binarised (> 0) -> inverse re-orientation to the raw grid -> uint8 {0,1} with the dataset image's x10 header -> outputs/masks/<tool>/<Dk>/<folder>/<stem>_mask.nii.gz
input_rule.reference_for_semi_auto_and_oracle: reference mask re-oriented with the same canonical transform
input_rule.orientation: canonical orientation for every tool; BEN and RBM receive it with axis 1 reversed (dorsal-up coronal slices) and their mask is reversed back (orientation_decision_ben_rbm)
input_rule.header_labels: headers as stored for every tool except deepbet, which receives anatomical labels (direction-cosine columns of axes 1 and 2 exchanged for D1, D2 and D5; voxel data unchanged)
input_rule.voxel_sizes: x10 for every tool; BET4Animal and RBM options are expressed in header units
input_rule.d2_header: D2: the tools receive a header voxel size of 0.1302 x 0.1302 x 0.8 mm (x10; notebooks/lib/config.py TOOL_INPUT_AFFINE_X10), with which the published D2 masks were computed; only BET, BET4Animal, RBM and ANTs use the voxel size

orientation_decision_ben_rbm.decision: option B: BEN and RBM receive the canonical x10 image with axis 1 reversed (dorsal-up coronal slices) and their mask is reversed back
orientation_decision_ben_rbm.rationale: BEN documents RIA as its rodent orientation, which for the canonical images equals canonical with axis 1 reversed; dorsal-up is the conventional orientation of 2D slice networks (RBM documents none).

threads_and_devices.cpu_tools: one process per scan pinned to one logical CPU (taskset), OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/ITK threads = 1; 80 workers in parallel on CPUs 16-95
threads_and_devices.gpu_tools: one process for all scans of a tool, sequentially on the GPU (CUDA device 0), CPU affinity 16-95, 80 threads
threads_and_devices.subprocess_environment: numpy's MKL_* variables are removed from the environment of the external tools (they make `import torch` fail in deepbet and SAM2)

samson_full_auto.call: relative_coordinates = template_relative_coordinates(template x10); part = canonical[:, :, z0:z1+1] (image_slices of dataset_settings samson_ap); boxes = generate_boxes(part, median_radius, numpass, t0, t1); full, candidates = segment_volume(part, [(boxes, False), (boxes, True)])

parameters.median_otsu: dataset_settings.json median_otsu ((2,5) if canonical axis-1 size < 140 else (1,3))

samson_full_auto.input: x10 canonical (array only; header not read)

samson_semi_auto.call: best = find_best_mask_indexes(evaluate_slices(candidates, reference[:, :, z0:z1+1])); semi = candidates[arange, best] (per slice, the candidate with the highest Jaccard against the reference mask: oracle selection, a disclosed Methods choice)

runner.usage: python sam2_run.py jobs.json; jobs.json = {checkpoint, jobs: [{input, boxes (.npy Full-Auto boxes), z0, z1, output}]}

sam2_samson_boxes.input: x10 canonical (array only); mask saved with the input header

versions.FSL packages: fsl-bet2 2111.4, fsl-newimage 2203.11, fsl-avwutils 2209.2, fsl-base 2309.2 (FSL 6.0.7.4 release versions)
fsl-bet2 2111.8, fsl-newimage 2203.12, fsl-avwutils 2209.3, fsl-base 2502.1 (FSL 6.0.7.17 release versions)

bet4animal.derivation: -z 6 (mouse) multiplies the real voxel sizes by 16, 12, 20 and the radius by 16 (4 -> 64 mm). On the x10 input, the scales 1.6, 1.2, 2.0 give the same scaled voxel sizes and -r 40 the same scaled radius (40 x 1.6 = 64 mm).

deepbet.call: from deepbet import run_bet; run_bet([input_x10], [brain], [mask], [tiv], threshold=0.95, n_dilate=0, no_gpu=False, skip_broken=False)
deepbet.device: cuda (required: CPU masks differ by 8-16 voxels)

versions.tensorflow-gpu: 1.15.4 (runs on the CPU: CUDA 10.0 libraries absent)
versions.repository: https://github.com/yu02019/BEN commit f23ed394f15c499e682bd44482bd89ff361d7c38 (2024-05-17), no tracked file modified
https://github.com/CAMRIatUNC/RodentMRISkullStripping commit dfa1a123495628d5d8ffe576999f8f1ddfd1973a (2021-11-15); working-tree differences are line endings only

runner.usage: python rbm_unet_run_padded.py jobs.json; jobs.json = {model_path, jobs: [{input, output, voxsize}]}

parameters.resampling: in plane only (slice thickness kept), linear; label map back with nearest neighbour

rbm.padding: slices narrower than 128 voxels after resampling are zero-padded to 128 and cropped back (runner); inactive for D1-D7 (smallest resampled size 150 voxels)

parameters.script defaults: N4 shrink 4/2, antsAI initial affine, SyN[0.1,3,0] with CC radius 4, 100x100x70x20, Atropos 3 classes

ants.padding: images with fewer than 8 slices (D4: 6) are zero-padded along axis 2 with pad = ceil((8 - n) / 2) empty slices at each end, affine @ translate(0, 0, -pad) (sform = qform), output prefix '<prefix>padded_', mask cropped back [:, :, pad:-pad] (N4 shrink 4 fails otherwise)
